subject: Route enemy patrol coordinates through virtual SetState
description: Old schema-12 representative `parity-random-save-replays-60s-15x/traces/Savegame_linux2/Profile_002/ExQuickSave/replay-011-session-0001.jsonl.zst` first diverged after frame 1312 on Soldiers144 and 145. Original exposed `LeaveAttentiveMode` with Green alert for both patrol members, while Rust exposed their replacement Move transitions with Yellow alert. The common `CoordinatePatrol` handler calls `StopAll`, then its movement arms call virtual `SetState(STATE_DEFAULT, SUBSTATE_DEFAULT_PATROL_ENROUTE[/RUNNING])` before `GoTo` (`original-code/RHartificialintelligence.cpp:7136-7158,7772-7835`; the pure-virtual declaration is `original-code/RHartificialintelligence.h:1222`, and the enemy override is `original-code/RHartificialmalignity.h:236`; `original-code/RHelementactornpc.cpp:5019-5024`). For an enemy soldier, `RHArtificialMalignity::SetState` owns the script callback, raw state assignment, `SetAttentiveMode(false)`, and final `SetAlertStatus(ALERT_GREEN)` (`original-code/RHartificialmalignity.cpp:9145-9160,9223-9275,9402-9413,9544`); the leave-attentive element is authored by `RHElementActorSoldier::SetAttentiveMode` (`original-code/RHelementactorsoldier.cpp:2082-2112`). Rust dispatched the stimulus through `AiController::coordinate_patrol`, whose base-only `set_ai_state` bypassed that enemy virtual tail. Commit `f766104e2` separates the shared eligibility/StopAll/geometry calculation from owner effects, routes enemy walk/run results through `EnemyAi::set_state`, and holds only newly authored patrol movement behind a leave-attentive transition that actually launches; an already-unalerted no-change control proves movement is not spuriously deferred. The focused walk/run/no-change regression `patrol_coordinate_uses_enemy_virtual_state_before_walk_and_run` passes 1/1. The committed scope is exactly `crates/robin_engine/src/ai.rs`, `crates/robin_engine/src/ai/controller.rs`, `crates/robin_engine/src/ai_enemy/event_handlers.rs`, and `crates/robin_engine/src/ai_enemy/mod.rs`, with formatting and diff checks clean. Authoritative combined runner `/home/phire/robinhood/target/parity/examples/original_parity_replay` (base HEAD `0d250c7ad440e7351ca42697faeca3171fcf2838`, frozen diff SHA-256 `5b099cf99b0fc5079a452034cde2f4fd3053e574bfe145964964307bafc7d57d`, runner SHA-256 `226d83c5deac0a89007d5fc1661cd5bb188d7d4c4908076a525486650679b6de`, size 65,888,107 bytes, mtime `2026-08-11 17:18:37.685 +0200`) matches the representative through exact EOF after final scan frame 1850 and adjacent control `parity-random-save-replays-60s-15x/traces/Savegame_linux2/Profile_002/ExQuickSave/replay-010-session-0001.jsonl.zst` through exact EOF after final scan frame 1690, both with exit status 0.
